# Locality Guide: Barsebäck parish, Harjager härad, Malmöhus, Sweden (1680–1750)

## Jurisdiction overview
- **Parish:** Barsebäck, Lutheran (Church of Sweden), Harjager härad, Malmöhus County
- **Diocesan see:** Lund
- **Skåne ceded from Denmark to Sweden:** Treaty of Roskilde, 1658
- **Records for 1680-1750:** All in Swedish, Church of Sweden
- **Neighbouring parish in same volume series:** Hofterup

## Available record types (all browse-only on FamilySearch)

### Church records — primary source
| Record type | Swedish term | Value |
|---|---|---|
| Household examination register | Husförhörslängd | **Highest priority** — records every parishioner's origin parish |
| Baptism/birth register | Dopbok / Födelsebok | Names parents; confirms parentage |
| Marriage register | Vigselbok | Records marriage of Jöns+Elena |
| Burial register | Dödbok | May give age at death |
| In-migration register | Inflyttningslängd | Records newcomers with origin |
| Out-migration register | Utflyttningslängd | Documents departures |

### FamilySearch volumes for Barsebäck (all 0% indexed, browse-only)
| Image Group | Images | Coverage |
|---|---|---|
| 004514823_001 | 157 | Barsebäck 1648–1861 |
| 004514823_002 | 428 | Barsebäck 1648–1861 |
| 004514823_003 | 164 | Barsebäck 1648–1861 |

### Mantalslängder (poll/tax registers)
Available 1642–1820 at https://sok.riksarkivet.se/mantalslangder

- Indelningsverket: https://sok.riksarkivet.se/grill

| Repository | Holdings | Access |
|---|---|---|
| FamilySearch | Malmöhus Church Records (collection 1974200, browse-only); indexed baptism/marriage/burial extracts | Free |
| ArkivDigital (arkivdigital.se) | High-res Malmöhus church record scans | Subscription |

5. Husförhörslängd in Skåne begin ca. 1686; inflyttningslängd coverage varies by parish.
6. Records in 18th-century Swedish handwriting (äldre götisk stil).
